title: Lock Admin V0.2 runtime and preview boundary
summary: Admin V0.2 may render contracts and controller-only previews, but it must not implement or claim runtime filtering, listing/grid rendering, or deep integration adapters in the first slice.
rationale: The first slice is admin architecture and saved configuration, not frontend runtime behavior.
alternatives_considered: Build runtime filtering during first slice
Add listing/grid preview to the modal
risks: Preview UI can accidentally imply frontend runtime behavior exists.
